title: Little Ming’s Environmental Protection
synopsis: Li Ming decides to make a difference.

fullText.simplified:
小明做环保

    小明爸爸是一位环境保护志愿者。他爸爸和朋友们每个周末都会去山上转一转，捡捡垃圾，看看有没有树木被破坏的情况什么的。他们偶尔也会带上小明，慢慢地小明也开始关心环保了。
    小明是小区里的孩子王，小区里的孩子都听他的。看到爸爸和他的朋友们为环保忙东忙西，小明也打算为环保做点什么。小明看到小区里的孩子们放学以后除了玩儿，没有别的事情。他决定把孩子们组织起来，带着他们一起做环保志愿者。
    孩子们听了小明的介绍觉得挺好玩儿的，大家都愿意做志愿者。他们一起捡垃圾，提醒人们垃圾分类什么的。后来时间长了，孩子们就坚持不下去了。原因有两个：一是因为做志愿者又脏又累又无聊，没有踢足球、打篮球有意思。二是因为孩子们的父母不让他们做，父母们觉得孩子们是在瞎折腾，尤其还是跟着小明这个捣蛋鬼，更不会有什么好事儿了。
    小明知道后，气得脸都绿了。他说：“什么？这都是什么原因啊？我调皮捣蛋怎么了，调皮捣蛋的孩子就不能做好事了吗？好吧，你们不做就算了，我一定要让大人们看看我这个坏孩子是怎么做好事的。”
    从那以后，小明更努力了。每天放学以后，他会在小区的垃圾桶旁提醒人们垃圾分类；周末的时间，他也不睡懒觉了，自己准备环保材料，发给小区里锻炼的人们……就这样，认识小明的人都说他变了，变成了一个努力、认真的好孩子。小区居委会还给他发了一个大奖状，表扬他是爱护环境的好学生。以前那些放弃做志愿者的孩子们又回来了，小明成了环保小明星。
fullText.traditional:
小明做環保

    小明爸爸是一位環境保護志願者。他爸爸和朋友們每個週末都會去山上轉一轉，撿撿垃圾，看看有沒有樹木被破壞的情況甚麼的。他們偶爾也會帶上小明，慢慢地小明也開始關心環保了。
    小明是小區裡的孩子王，小區裡的孩子都聽他的。看到爸爸和他的朋友們為環保忙東忙西，小明也打算為環保做點什麼。小明看到小區裡的孩子們放學以後除了玩兒，沒有別的事情。他決定把孩子們組織起來，帶著他們一起做環保志願者。
    孩子們聽了小明的介紹覺得挺好玩兒的，大家都願意做志願者。他們一起撿垃圾，提醒人們垃圾分類甚麼的。後來時間長了，孩子們就堅持不下去了。原因有兩個：一是因為做志願者又髒又累又無聊，沒有踢足球、打籃球有意思。二是因為孩子們的父母不讓他們做，父母們覺得孩子們是在瞎折騰，尤其還是跟著小明這個搗蛋鬼，更不會有什麼好事兒了。
    小明知道後，氣得臉都綠了。他說：“什麼？這都是什麼原因啊？我調皮搗蛋怎麼了，調皮搗蛋的孩子就不能做好事了嗎？好吧，你們不做就算了，我一定要讓大人們看看我這個壞孩子是怎麼做好事的。”
    從那以後，小明更努力了。每天放學以後，他會在小區的垃圾桶旁提醒人們垃圾分類；週末的時間，他也不睡懶覺了，自己準備環保材料，發給小區裡鍛鍊的人們……就這樣，認識小明的人都說他變了，變成了一個努力、認真的好孩子。小區居委會還給他發了一個大獎狀，表揚他是愛護環境的好學生。以前那些放棄做志願者的孩子們又回來了，小明成了環保小明星。

He decided to get them together and take them to serve as environmental protection volunteers together.

sentences.traditional: 後來時間長了，孩子們就堅持不下去了。

sentences.traditional: 原因有兩個：
sentences.pinyin: yuán yīn yǒu liǎng ge
sentences.english: As time passed, the kids couldn’t keep it up.

sentences.simplified: 一是因为做志愿者又脏又累又无聊，没有踢足球、打篮球有意思。
sentences.traditional: 一是因為做志願者又髒又累又無聊，沒有踢足球、打籃球有意思。
sentences.pinyin: yī shì yīn wèi zuò zhì yuàn zhě yòu zāng yòu lèi yòu wú liáo méi yǒu tī zú qiú dǎ lán qiú yǒu yì si
sentences.english: There were two reasons:

sentences.simplified: 二是因为孩子们的父母不让他们做，父母们觉得孩子们是在瞎折腾，
sentences.traditional: 二是因為孩子們的父母不讓他們做，父母們覺得孩子們是在瞎折騰，
sentences.pinyin: èr shì yīn wèi hái zi men de fù mǔ bú ràng tā men zuò fù mǔ men jué de hái zi men shì zài xiā zhē teng
sentences.english: The first is because being a volunteer is dirty, tiring, and boring, and not as fun as playing football or basketball.

sentences.traditional: 尤其還是跟著小明這個搗蛋鬼，更不會有什麼好事兒了。
sentences.pinyin: yóu qí hái shi gēn zhe xiǎo míng zhè ge dǎo dàn guǐ gèng bú huì yǒu shén me hǎo shì'r le
sentences.english: The second is because their parents wouldn’t let them. The parents felt that their kids were foolishly wasting time.
In particular, they were following after the troublemaker Little Ming, so nothing good could come out of it.

sentences.simplified: 小明知道后，气得脸都绿了。
sentences.traditional: 小明知道後，氣得臉都綠了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo míng zhī dào hòu qì de liǎn dōu lǜ le

sentences.traditional: 他說：“什麼？這都是什麼原因啊？
sentences.pinyin: tā shuō shén me zhè dōu shì shén me yuán yīn a
sentences.english: After Little Ming found out, he was so angry that his face turned green.

sentences.simplified: 我调皮捣蛋怎么了，调皮捣蛋的孩子就不能做好事了吗？
sentences.traditional: 我調皮搗蛋怎麼了，調皮搗蛋的孩子就不能做好事了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: wǒ tiáo pí dǎo dàn zěn me le tiáo pí dǎo dàn de hái zi jiù bù néng zuò hǎo shì le ma
sentences.english: He said, “What? What kinds of reasons are these?

sentences.simplified: 好吧，你们不做就算了，我一定要让大人们看看我这个坏孩子是怎么做好事的。”
sentences.traditional: 好吧，你們不做就算了，我一定要讓大人們看看我這個壞孩子是怎麼做好事的。”
sentences.pinyin: hǎo ba nǐ men bú zuò jiù suàn le wǒ yí dìng yào ràng dà ren men kàn kan wǒ zhè ge huài hái zi shì zěn me zuò hǎo shì de
sentences.english: So what if I’m a troublemaker? Kids that are troublemakers aren’t capable of doing good things?
Alright, it’s fine if you won’t do it anymore. I’ll definitely make those adults see how a bad kid like me can do good.”

sentences.simplified: 从那以后，小明更努力了。
sentences.traditional: 從那以後，小明更努力了。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu xiǎo míng gèng nǔ lì le

sentences.simplified: 每天放学以后，他会在小区的垃圾桶旁提醒人们垃圾分类；
sentences.traditional: 每天放學以後，他會在小區的垃圾桶旁提醒人們垃圾分類；
sentences.pinyin: měi tiān fàng xué yǐ hòu tā huì zài xiǎo qū de lā jī tǒng páng tí xǐng rén men lā jī fēn lèi
sentences.english: From that point onward, Little Ming worked even harder.

sentences.simplified: 周末的时间，他也不睡懒觉了，自己准备环保材料，发给小区里锻炼的人们……
sentences.traditional: 週末的時間，他也不睡懶覺了，自己準備環保材料，發給小區裡鍛鍊的人們……

sentences.english: Every day after school, he stood by the garbage bins in his community, reminding people to sort their trash.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，认识小明的人都说他变了，变成了一个努力、认真的好孩子。
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，認識小明的人都說他變了，變成了一個努力、認真的好孩子。
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng rèn shi xiǎo míng de rén dōu shuō tā biàn le biàn chéng le yí ge nǔ lì rèn zhēn de hǎo hái zi
sentences.english: He no longer slept in during the weekend. He prepared environmental protection materials to give to people exercising in his community …

sentences.simplified: 小区居委会还给他发了一个大奖状，表扬他是爱护环境的好学生。

sentences.english: In this way, people who knew Little Ming all said he had changed. He had become a good kid who was hardworking and conscientious.

sentences.simplified: 以前那些放弃做志愿者的孩子们又回来了，小明成了环保小明星。
sentences.traditional: 以前那些放棄做志願者的孩子們又回來了，小明成了環保小明星。

sentences.english: The residential committee even gave him a major award, commending him for being a good student who cares about the environment.

sentence_translations: Little Ming’s Environmental Protection
Little Ming’s father is an environmental protection volunteer.
Every weekend, his father went up the mountain with friends to do a round picking up trash and checking if there are any damaged trees.
They occasionally took Little Ming along. Little Ming gradually also started to care about environmental protection.
Little Ming is “king” among the kids in his residential community, and all the kids in the community listen to what he says.
Seeing his father and his father’s friends busy protecting the environment, ..
.. Little Ming also decided to do something for environmental protection.
Little Ming noticed that the kids in his community do nothing but play after school.
He decided to get them together and take them to serve as environmental protection volunteers together.
The kids listened to Little Ming’s explanation and thought it would be fun, so they all agreed to be volunteers.
They picked up trash together and reminded people to do things like garbage sorting.
As time passed, the kids couldn’t keep it up.
There were two reasons:
The first is because being a volunteer is dirty, tiring, and boring, and not as fun as playing football or basketball.
The second is because their parents wouldn’t let them. The parents felt that their kids were foolishly wasting time.
In particular, they were following after the troublemaker Little Ming, so nothing good could come out of it.
After Little Ming found out, he was so angry that his face turned green.
He said, “What? What kinds of reasons are these?
So what if I’m a troublemaker? Kids that are troublemakers aren’t capable of doing good things?
Alright, it’s fine if you won’t do it anymore. I’ll definitely make those adults see how a bad kid like me can do good.”
From that point onward, Little Ming worked even harder.
Every day after school, he stood by the garbage bins in his community, reminding people to sort their trash.
He no longer slept in during the weekend. He prepared environmental protection materials to give to people exercising in his community …
In this way, people who knew Little Ming all said he had changed. He had become a good kid who was hardworking and conscientious.
The residential committee even gave him a major award, commending him for being a good student who cares about the environment.
The kids who previously gave up volunteering also returned, and Little Ming became a little environmental protection star.
